t: This is the Queen Mary Memorial, a London memorial to Mary of Teck. She was Queen of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions, and Empress of India, from 1910 until 1936, as the wife of King George V. The memorial was made by the Scottish sculptor Sir William Reid Dick. He was known for his innovative stylisation of form in monument sculpture, and for the simplicity of his portraits. He was knighted by George V in 1935, and later became Sculptor in Ordinary for Scotland to both George VI and Queen Elizabeth.
